findings: The Kings-only first occurrence 1KI 1:6 says Adonijah was born after Absalom, and 1KI 2:7 later calls Absalom Solomon’s brother. The family relation is already established in the preceding Samuel narrative: fixed WEB 2SA 13:1 calls Absalom “the son of David,” and 2SA 3:3 identifies him as Maacah’s son. Thus the Japanese article note is not a future Kings spoiler in the wider canonical sequence, though it is not established by 1KI 1:6 alone; retain qualified for the cross-book basis.

The linked Japanese article is about David’s son Absalom (article lines 174 and 181); its source warning at line 156 and lack of citations limit its authority. The profile’s Kings occurrences and exclusion of the similarly spelled Abishalom at 15:2/10 remain textually appropriate.

findings: 1KI 15:8 explicitly names Asa as Abijam’s son and successor. The immediately preceding context identifies Abijam as king of Judah (15:1, 7), so the title “Asa of Judah” and the note that he is king of Judah do not require importing the later 15:9 regnal-year statement. The 15:9 chronology remains beyond knownBy and is not exposed by the reviewed note.

The linked Asa of Judah article is the correct person: its infobox identifies the King of Judah, its predecessor entry gives Abijah, and its family section discusses the son relationship. This identity evidence aligns with the Kings context.

profileSnapshot.subtitleJa: アビヤムの子
profileSnapshot.summaryJa: アビヤムの子で、父の後を継いだ人物として記されています。列王記上15:8では、アビヤムの後にアサが統治を継いだと述べます。

facts.textJa: 列王記上15:9は、アサがユダを治め始めた時期をヤロブアムの治世年で示します。
アサは主の目にかなうことを行ったと記されます。
アサは母マアカがアシェラ像を作ったため、王母の地位から退け、その像を切り倒してキデロンの谷で焼きました。
高き所は取り除かれなかった一方、アサの心は生涯主に向いていたと記されています。
列王記上15:16は、アサとイスラエル王バシャの間に両者の全期間を通じて戦いがあったとします。
アサは主の家と王宮に残る銀と金をダマスコの王ベン・ハダドへ送り、同盟を求めます。
アサはラマの石材と木材を運び出すようユダに命じ、ゲバとミツパの建設に用いました。
列王記上15:23は、アサの晩年に足の病を患ったと伝えます。
アサの死後、子ヨシャファトが王位を継ぎました。

profileSnapshot.identityNoteJa: 対象はアサの子でユダ王として紹介されるヨシャファト。4:3のアヒルドの子の記録官、4:17のパルアの子の行政官とは別人。

facts.textJa: 第三年にユダ王ヨシャファトがイスラエル王を訪ねます。
イスラエル王がラモト・ギレアドへの出陣を持ちかけ、ヨシャファトは自分と民・馬が相手と同じだと答えます。
ヨシャファトは、まず主の言葉を求めるよう求めます。
ヨシャファトは、主に尋ねる預言者がほかにいないかと尋ねます。
ミカヤについてイスラエル王から否定的に説明されたとき、ヨシャファトはそのように言わないよう求めます。
イスラエル王とヨシャファトは、サマリアの門の入口にある広場で、それぞれ王座に座ります。
イスラエル王はヨシャファトに、ミカヤが自分に悪いことを預言すると言ったと述べます。
イスラエル王とヨシャファトはラモト・ギレアドへ向かいます。
イスラエル王は変装すると告げ、ヨシャファトには王服を着るよう言います。
戦車隊長たちはヨシャファトをイスラエル王だと思い、彼に戦いを挑みます。ヨシャファトは叫びます。
列王記上22:41は、アハブ第4年にアサの子ヨシャファトがユダを治め始めたと記します。
ヨシャファトは35歳で王位につき、エルサレムで25年間治めたと記されます。
ヨシャファトはイスラエル王と和平を結びます。
本文はヨシャファトのその他の行いと武勇がユダ王たちの年代記に記されていると述べます。
ヨシャファトはタルシシュ船を作らせて金を求めに行かせますが、船はエツヨン・ゲベルで難破します。
アハブの子アハズヤは、自分の家来をヨシャファトの家来と船に乗せるよう申し出ますが、ヨシャファトは断ります。
ヨシャファトは死んで父祖とともに葬られ、子ヨラムが代わって王になります。
イスラエル王アハズヤの即位年は、ユダ王ヨシャファトの第17年と記されます。

wikipedia.title: Jehoshaphat
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、アサの子でユダ王となったヨシャファトを扱っています。

wikipediaBodyReview.locator: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jehoshaphat, lines 157–184, 190–191, live read 2026-10-16 UTC.
wikipediaBodyReview.support: The article is the correct Judah king and explicitly disambiguates another Jehoshaphat; all reviewed family/role claims match the fixed witness.

rows.basis: 1KI 15:24 identifies Jehoshaphat as Asa’s son and successor; the later verses and facts track his Judah reign and the episode with Ahab without advancing their gates. The article opening L157–184 distinguishes the Judah king from the high priest and lists Asa as father; L190–191 specifically summarizes Kings 15:24 and 22:1–50.

findings: 1KI 16:1 names Jehu son of Hanani; 16:7 calls him prophet; 16:12 attributes the judgment against Baasha’s house to the word spoken through Jehu. The profile’s introductory description is limited to fatherhood, and its prophet/fulfilment facts are gated to 16:7/12.

primarySourceChecks.sourceText: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

profileSnapshot.subtitleJa: ハナニの子として名が記される人物。
profileSnapshot.summaryJa: 列王記上16:1では、ハナニの子エフーに主の言葉が臨んだと記されます。

facts.textJa: 列王記上16:7は、エフーを預言者と呼び、バアシャとその家についての主の言葉を伝えたと記します。
列王記上16:12は、ジムリによるバアシャの家の滅亡を、エフーを通して語られた言葉の成就として記します。

primarySourceChecks.sourceText: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.
He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;
and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.
Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.
Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.
Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”
So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.
Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.
The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’
All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.
He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.
Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.
Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;
for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

“Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,
behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.
For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”
He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

profileSnapshot.subtitleJa: ネバトの子。エフライム人で、ゼレダ出身と記される。
profileSnapshot.summaryJa: 列王記上11:26は、ネバトの子ヤロブアムをエフライム人、ゼレダ出身、ソロモンの家来として紹介します。同節は母ゼルアがやもめだったことも記します。

facts.textJa: ソロモンは、若いヤロブアムが有能であると見て、ヨセフの家の労役を監督させます。
アヒヤはエルサレムを出たヤロブアムに道で会います。
アヒヤは衣を裂いて十片をヤロブアムに渡し、王国の十部族を彼に与えるという主の言葉を告げます。
ソロモンがヤロブアムを殺そうとしたため、彼はエジプトへ逃れ、ソロモンの死までそこにいます。
イスラエルの会衆はヤロブアムを呼び戻し、彼とともにレハブアムのもとへ来ます。
列王記上12:15は、アヒヤを通してヤロブアムに語られた主の言葉が実現する過程として、レハブアムの対応を説明します。
イスラエルの人々はヤロブアムを呼び、イスラエル全体の王にします。
ヤロブアムはシェケムを築き、そこに住み、さらにペヌエルを築きます。
ヤロブアムは、民がエルサレムへ戻れば王国がダビデの家に戻るのではないかと考えます。
ヤロブアムは第八の月の祭りを定め、ベテルの祭壇で犠牲をささげます。
ユダから来た神の人がベテルの祭壇に向かったとき、ヤロブアムはその祭壇のそばに立っています。
ヤロブアムは神の人を捕らえるよう手を伸ばしますが、その手は動かなくなります。
ヤロブアムは高き所の祭司を民の中から任命し続けます。
ヤロブアムの子アビヤが病気になります。
ヤロブアムは妻に変装してシロへ行き、預言者アヒヤに子のことを尋ねるよう頼みます。
アヒヤは、主がヤロブアムを民の中から引き上げ、イスラエルの指導者としたことを伝えます。
アヒヤはヤロブアムの家に下る裁きについて告げます。
アビヤだけが墓に葬られると告げられ、ヤロブアムの家の中で彼に良いものが見いだされたとされます。
主がヤロブアムの家を断つ王をイスラエルに立てるという言葉が告げられます。
イスラエルが引き渡される理由として、ヤロブアム自身の罪と、彼がイスラエルに罪を犯させたことが挙げられます。
ヤロブアムの妻がティルツァに戻ると、家の敷居で子どもが死にます。
ヤロブアムの戦いと治世のその他の出来事は、イスラエル王の年代記に記されたとされます。
ヤロブアムは22年間治めて死に、子ナダブが王位を継ぎます。
レハブアムとヤロブアムの間には絶えず戦争がありました。
ユダ王アビヤムの即位は、ヤロブアムの治世第18年に置かれます。
レハブアムとヤロブアムの間の戦争は、レハブアムの生涯を通じて続いたと記されます。
アビヤムの行いと、彼とヤロブアムとの戦争が記されます。
アサの即位は、ヤロブアムの治世第20年に置かれます。
ヤロブアムの子ナダブがイスラエルの王になります。
バアシャは王位に就くとヤロブアムの家を打ち、主の言葉に従ってその家を滅ぼしたと記されます。
ヤロブアムが犯しイスラエルにも犯させた罪が、主を怒らせた理由として述べられます。
バアシャの子エラはヤロブアムの道を歩んだと評されます。
主はバアシャに対し、ヤロブアムの道を歩み民に罪を犯させたと告げます。
バアシャの家がヤロブアムの家のようになると告げられます。
バアシャの悪が、ヤロブアムの家のようにするという主の言葉と関連づけられます。
ジムリの罪は、ヤロブアムの道を歩いたこととして記されます。
オムリはヤロブアムの道を歩き、その罪によってイスラエルに罪を犯させたとされます。
アハブはヤロブアムの罪を軽いことのように扱い、シドン人の王エトバアルの娘イゼベルを妻にします。
アハブの家に下る裁きは、ヤロブアムとバアシャの家にならうと告げられます。
アハブの子アハズヤは父母とヤロブアムの道を歩き、イスラエルに罪を犯させたと評されます。

wikipediaBodyReview.locator: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeroboam, lines 155–180, live read 2026-10-16 UTC.
wikipediaBodyReview.support: The article’s main subject is the Kings Jeroboam son of Nebat and it covers the same narrative, but its own discussion notes unresolved historicity questions.

rows.basis: 1KI 11:26 gives Jeroboam son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zeredah and Solomon’s servant; the summary stays there and later facts track stated verses, including 12:20 and 12:25. The page L155–180 identifies Jeroboam I, gives Nebat and Zeruah, and links the northern kingdom; it also records scholarly discussion about historicity/possible retrojection at L180. The profile is textually the Kings figure, while its historical identity should retain the qualification.

findings: 1KI 2:5 and 2:32 directly call Amasa “son of Jether.” The profile limits its assertion to that book and does not merge the Samuel form Ithra. The Amasa article L123 says Jether was also called Ithra and mentions differing Israelite/Ishmaelite descriptions; the related-section link is transparent but those cross-book identity details are not independently resolvable from Kings.

The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

facts.textJa: ダビデは、ヨアブがアブネルとアマサを殺したことをソロモンに告げます。

Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”
But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

profileSnapshot.subtitleJa: シドン人の王エトバアルの娘で、アハブの妻。
profileSnapshot.summaryJa: 列王記上16:31は、イゼベルをシドン人の王エトバアルの娘として、アハブの妻に迎えられた人物と記します。
profileSnapshot.identityNoteJa: 初出16:31時点の紹介は親族関係に限り、18章・21章の行為や結末は後の節で初めて示される。

facts.textJa: 列王記上18:4は、イゼベルが主の預言者たちを殺そうとしていた時、オバデヤが百人を隠したと記します。
カルメル山へ集めるよう命じられたバアルの預言者たちとアシェラの預言者たちは、イゼベルの食卓で食べていたとされます。
アハブは、エリヤが行ったことをイゼベルに告げます。
イゼベルは使者をエリヤに送り、命を取ると告げます。
イゼベルは、食事を取らず気落ちするアハブのもとへ来て理由を尋ねます。
イゼベルはアハブに、ナボテのぶどう畑を渡すと言います。
町の長老と有力者は、イゼベルの手紙の指示に従います。
町の人々はナボテが石打ちにされて死んだとイゼベルへ知らせます。
イゼベルはアハブに、ナボテのぶどう畑を所有するよう促します。
エリヤは、イゼベルについて、イズレエルの城壁のそばで犬に食べられるという主の言葉を伝えます。
列王記上21:25は、アハブが悪を行ったことにイゼベルが関与したと評します。

primarySourceChecks.sourceText: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.
Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.
Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”
Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

facts.textJa: アハズはヨタムの子として、ペカの治世中にユダ王となりました。
アハズは二十歳で即位し、エルサレムで十六年間治めたと記されます。

アハズは主の家と王宮の財宝を取り、アッシリア王への贈り物として送りました。

ウリヤは、アハズの指示と図面に従って祭壇を造りました。
アハズは新しい祭壇での供え物を命じ、青銅の祭壇は自分が伺いを立てるために使うと述べました。
アハズの命令どおりにウリヤが行ったと記されます。
アハズは青銅の台座の装飾を外し、青銅の海を石の敷物に移しました。
アハズの他の事績はユダの王たちの記録にあるとされます。
アハズの死後、子ヒゼキヤが王位を継いだと記されます。

They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “The LORD says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”
Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
The LORD’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”
So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.
When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”
Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”
Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.
He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps the LORD’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”
He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “The LORD says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”
He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.
He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”
Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.
He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.
This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”
She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

profileSnapshot.subtitleJa: イスラエルの神として「主」と呼ばれる
profileSnapshot.summaryJa: 列王記下1:3では、「イスラエルに神がいないのか」という言葉と「主の使い」への言及が現れます。本文では「主」「神」などの表現で神が語られ、人々の祈りや預言を通じてその言葉が伝えられます。
profileSnapshot.identityNoteJa: WEBの英語表記 “LORD” と “God” は文脈により異なる言い方です。別の神名や「神の人」という預言者への呼称は、この神への用例と区別しました。

facts.textJa: 主は使者を通じてアハズヤの問いに答え、エリヤを通して王の死を告げます。章末はその言葉どおりの死を記します。
主はエリヤを天に上げ、エリシャは主に呼びかけてヨルダンを渡ります。水や町の水源についても主の言葉が語られます。
主の預言者エリシャを通じ、水を得ることとモアブへの勝利が告げられます。
主の言葉を通じてシュネムの女性に子が約束され、後に子が生き返ります。食物の危機やパンの分配にも主の言葉が関わります。
ナアマンの癒やしを通じ、イスラエルの神への言及がなされます。ナアマンは主にささげる礼拝について願い、エリシャは主の名にかけて贈り物を拒みます。
エリシャは主に祈り、主は従者の目を開き、アラム軍を盲目にします。包囲下のサマリアでは王が主の助けを求めます。
エリシャが告げた主の言葉どおり、サマリアの食糧事情が変わります。
主は飢饉を告げ、エリシャを通じてハザエルの将来について示します。ユダ王たちの評価も主の目にかなうかどうかで記されます。
エリシャの使者は主の言葉としてエフーに油を注ぎ、アハブ家への裁きを告げます。
エフーは主の言葉をアハブ家に対する行動の根拠として述べます。本文は主がエフーに語り、彼の子孫が四代まで王位に就くと告げます。
祭司エホヤダは主と王、民の間で契約を結びます。民は主の家で礼拝を再開し、バアルの家を壊します。
ヨアシュの治世に主の家の修理資金が集められ、職人たちが修繕を行います。
イスラエル王たちは主の目に悪とされますが、主はイスラエルに恵みを示し、アラムの圧迫から救います。
ユダとイスラエルの王たちの行いが主の目を基準に評価され、預言者ヨナを通して主の言葉が伝えられます。
王たちの治世が主の目にかなうか否かで記され、主の怒りがイスラエルに臨むと説明されます。
アハズは主の家の器具を取り、主の家と王宮からアッシリア王へ贈り物を送ります。本文は彼の行いを主の目に悪いと評価します。
イスラエルの民が主の契約と戒めを捨てたことが、捕囚の理由として述べられます。主は預言者たちを通して警告したと記されます。
ヒゼキヤは主を信頼し、主に従ったと記されます。アッシリア側の使者は主への信頼を疑わせる言葉を述べます。
ヒゼキヤは主に祈り、主は預言者イザヤを通して答えます。主の使いがアッシリア陣営を打ったと記されます。
ヒゼキヤは主に祈り、主はイザヤを通して回復と後の捕囚を告げます。
マナセとアモンの行いは主の目に悪とされ、預言者たちは主の裁きを告げます。
ヒルキヤは主の家で律法の書を見つけ、女預言者フルダは主の裁きを告げます。主はヨシヤのへりくだりを聞いたと語ります。
ヨシヤは主の契約を民の前で確認し、主の家と礼拝を整えます。なお主の怒りはマナセの行いのためユダから去らないと記されます。
主の命令により諸国の軍勢がユダへ送られ、エルサレムの財宝が運び出されます。本文はこれを主の怒りと結び付けます。
主の家が焼かれ、その器具が運び出されます。章末の記述は主の家に関する設備を扱います。
